execution.implementation: Exact chain-A C-alpha correspondence and unweighted NumPy Kabsch calculation over retained RCSB coordinate snapshots

observations: Both retained chain-A structures contain 214 C-alpha atoms and all 214 pairs match by author residue identity.
The whole-chain Kabsch C-alpha RMSD is 7.130700 angstrom.
After the global fit, CORE, NMP, and LID RMSDs are 3.726713, 9.738001, and 11.238005 angstrom.
interpretation: The low independently fitted domain RMSDs and larger globally fitted NMP/LID deviations support substantial domain displacement between the deposited open and AP5-bound conformations.
limitations: The result is specific to chain-A C-alpha correspondence and the declared domain ranges.
RMSD does not estimate energy, kinetics, or conformational population.
Crystal packing, resolution, and ligand state differ between the entries.

provenance.note: The script records atom selection, correspondence, transform, global and domain RMSDs, retained hashes, and largest per-residue deviations; the separate Rosalind observation records launcher availability without a scientific job.

reproduction: Run python scripts/compute_alignment.py from the case directory.
Confirm the retained input hashes and compare the regenerated JSON with the preview.
